concept: The one primary action of a phone screen, floating at thumb reach: the loud white bead, a step bigger than an IconButton.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a coloured circle with a white plus (Material FAB in the brand colour)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a brand-coloured disc brings a hue; Pane’s loud action is the lit solid

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the FAB is the loud solid, the one solid fill on the screen, glowing in dark

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: 56px at the bottom end, the largest control, at thumb reach

derivation.consequence: a pressed control shrinks slightly, as something pushed
derivation.form: a press shrinks it slightly, as something pushed

options: A loud bead at the bottom end
variants.picked: A loud bead at the bottom end
variants.reason: A is the loud solid (P5) at thumb reach (P6). B brings a hue. C loses the floating reach.

root.why: the loud bead lit from above, glowing strong in dark

fixed.why: floats over the viewport at the bottom end, at thumb reach

contained.why: floats in its own container, for a panel or a demo

extended.why: with its label beside the icon on a wide screen or a first visit

icon.why: the glyph at the icon size, the same in every theme and on every scene

label.why: the label in the body size, semibold, the same in every theme and on every scene

active.why: a press shrinks it slightly, the same in every theme and on every scene

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring, the same in every theme and on every scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the bead, the same in every theme and on every scene

disabled.why: an off control dims and refuses presses, so it reads as there but not available

transform.why: the press shrink at press pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
